evidenceAccessPromise: Free Member access includes the same underlying public-source evidence used by every paid tier. Paid levels add curation, delivery, monitoring, exports, workflow tools and member services rather than exclusive evidence.
boundary: Membership access is being prepared. No payment should be taken until checkout, delivery, cancellation and account-access systems are live and verified. Paid plans are recurring membership payments that support the project and include member services; they are not charitable donations or automatically tax-deductible.

tiers.name: Supporter
tiers.summary: A low-cost way to support the project and receive the core weekly member service layer.
includes: Everything in Free Member, including the same underlying public-source evidence
benefits: Curated public-source drops and source collections
Selected supporter downloads and convenient formats
tiers.evidenceBoundary: The donation supports the project and added member services. The underlying public-source evidence remains available through Free Member access.

tiers.name: Intelligence Member
tiers.summary: The day-to-day intelligence service layer for readers who want evidence organised, monitored and delivered more frequently.
includes: Everything in Supporter and Free Member, including the same underlying public-source evidence
benefits: Full card context and evidence notes
Deeper evidence-bounded dossiers and organised research routes
tiers.evidenceBoundary: This level adds monitoring, organisation, analysis and delivery tools, not exclusive ownership of evidence.

tiers.name: Research Pro
tiers.summary: The advanced workspace layer for investigators, writers and serious public-record researchers who want stronger filters, exports and workflow tools.
includes: Everything in Intelligence Member, Supporter and Free Member, including the same underlying public-source evidence
benefits: Research queue and priority source requests
PDF, CSV and JSON research bundles
tiers.evidenceBoundary: Research Pro provides advanced organisation and research functions. Free Members still receive access to the same underlying public-source evidence.
tiers.requestBoundary: Priority requests enter a review queue. They do not guarantee that a record exists, can be lawfully obtained, or will support a requested conclusion.
